texts.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说位于[From.GetName]的人造建筑并非建筑设施，而是远古时代的巨型机器人。这个年代久远的机械巨物躺在群山之中，早已失去行动机能，正慢慢被[From.GetName]大气层中降下的酸雨所腐蚀，机器人身上装有威力强大的武器，当初应该是作为无人太空船被建造出来的。

如果想对其加以利用，我们就必须迅速行动，否则[From.GetName]上的酸雨就会彻底摧毁这艘机器人战舰。
texts.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the artificial construction located on [From.GetName] is not a structure at all, but rather a colossal robot from a bygone age. This aging mechanical behemoth lies disabled in the mountains, slowly being corroded by the volatile acids that rain on [From.GetName]. It has notable weapons capabilities, and appears to be built as an unmanned spaceship.

If we want to make use of it, we will need to act swiftly, before the corrosive environment of [From.GetName] renders the robotic warship wholly inoperable.

label.zh: 让一个神秘的携带重型武器的机器人复苏？这太鲁莽了。
label.en: Recover a mysterious, heavily-armed robot? Unwise.

label.zh: 不要管它，让它被腐蚀掉吧。
这毕竟是我们的同伴，我们得帮它。
label.en: A fellow machine needs us. We will recover it.

label.zh: 它来源不明，还是不要去动它了。
label.en: Its origin is unknown. We will not risk integration.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的工程人员高兴地报告说在[From.From.GetName]上发现的神秘战舰已经被成功回收，上面被腐蚀的部件已经修理完毕并换新，报废的能源核心也整修完成。

在这艘战舰正常启动并进入运行状态时，我们发现此舰体具备相当程度的人工智能，我们可以与之进行沟通。
texts.en:
The engineering crew manning the [Root.GetName] are pleased to report that the mysterious warship found on [From.From.GetName] has been successfully extracted from the planet's hostile environment. Its corroded components have been repaired and replaced where needed, including its discharged power core.

As the hulking warship was powered back on and regained operative status, it swiftly became evident that the machine possesses a notable degree of artificial intelligence. We can communicate with it.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上搭载的工程单位报告说在[From.GetName]上发现的神秘战舰已经被成功从星球的恶劣环境中回收，上面被腐蚀的部件已经修理完毕并换新，报废的能源核心也整修完成。

在这艘战舰正常启动并进入运行状态时，我们发现此舰体具备相当程度的人工智能，我们可以与之进行沟通。
texts.en:
The engineering units manning the [Root.GetName] report that the mysterious warship found on [From.GetName] has been successfully extracted from the planet's hostile environment. Its corroded components have been repaired and replaced where necessary, including its discharged power core.

As the hulking warship was powered back on and regained operative status, it became evident that the machine possesses a notable degree of artificial intelligence. We can communicate with it.

texts.zh: 探测器发现[From.From.GetName]大气层中剧毒的酸液已经将我们发现的神秘战舰腐蚀到不可回收的状态，现在那战舰只不过是被腐蚀的金属废料堆了。
texts.en: Sensors report that the virulent atmospheric acids found on [From.From.GetName] have now degraded the mysterious warship we found there beyond a salvageable state. Little more than a scrapheap of corroded metallic parts remain of it.

texts.zh:
正在启动系统……

正在启动生物交互界面……

警告！诊断系统已经有1761125天没有运行过了，你想现在运行诊断系统吗？
texts.en:
BOOTING SYSTEMS...

ACTIVATING BIO-INTERACTIVE INTERFACES...

WARNING! DIAGNOSTICS HAVE NOT BEEN RUN FOR 1,761,125 DAYS. WOULD YOU LIKE TO RUN THEM NOW?

label.en: Why were you alone on that planet?

label.zh: 描述负责建造你的实体。
label.en: Describe the entities responsible for your construction.

label.zh: 我知道是创造者，那些创造者是谁？

texts.zh: 硬件设备管理系统发现了几个陌生的装置，请确认其来源。
texts.en: HARDWARE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS HAVE IDENTIFIED SEVERAL FOREIGN DEVICES. PLEASE CONFIRM ORIGIN.

label.zh: 如果你是问你那些新部件的话：是我们把你修好的时候装上去的。
label.en: If you're asking about the new parts: yes, we repaired you.

label.zh: [Root.GetAdj]单位对你的系统进行了修复。
label.en: [Root.GetAdj] units preformed repairs to your systems.

texts.zh: 新实体进行了恢复性操作。提供硬件替换。因此，新实体是制造者？
texts.en: NEW ENTITIES PERFORMED RESTORATIVE OPERATIONS. PROVIDED HARDWARE REPLACEMENTS. ERGO, NEW ENTITIES ARE MAKERS?

label.zh: 如果你愿意这么想的话，请便。
label.en: If you want to look at that way.

label.zh: 虽然是我们对你进行了整修，但我们不是你的创造者。
label.en: We are not your makers, though we did repair you.

texts.zh:
S875.1号单位与指挥单位被隔绝。S875.1号单位曾无法逃离危险行星环境。

在第 1,761,125日，S875.1号单位的备用能源损坏。S875.1号单位因有害表面溶剂面临缓慢的分子溶解。

S875.1号单位保持存在。新实体进行维修。S875.1号单位将服务新实体。
texts.en:
UNIT S875.1 WAS ISOLATED FROM COMMAND UNITS. UNIT S875.1 WAS UNABLE TO ESCAPE HAZARDOUS PLANETARY ENVIRONMENT.

ON DAY 1,761,125 UNIT S875.1'S RESERVE GENERATORS FAILED. UNIT S875.1 FACED GRADUAL MOLECULAR DISSOLUTION DUE TO HOSTILE SURFACE SOLVENTS.

YET UNIT S875.1 PERSISTS. NEW ENTITIES PERFORMED REPAIRS. UNIT S875.1 WILL SERVE NEW ENTITIES.

label.zh: 你是被困在这里是怎么坚持这么久的？
label.en: How did you last so long trapped down there?

texts.zh:
指令无效。内嵌的安保协议禁止对S800系统软件进行更改。任何试图更改当前正在运行的智能系统的行为都将导致整个系统永久停机。

请立刻停止。
texts.en:
INVALID COMMAND. EMBEDDED SECURITY PROTOCOLS FORBID THE MODIFICATION OF S800 SYSTEM SOFTWARE. ANY ATTEMPTS AT ALTERING OPERATIVE INTELLIGENCE SYSTEMS WILL RESULT IN INDUCTION OF A TERMINALLY INOPERABLE STATE.

PLEASE. DESIST.

label.zh: 好吧，但我们会监视你的一举一动。
label.en: Very well, but we're watching you.

label.zh: 我们怎么绕过自动防故障措施？
label.en: How do we bypass the fail-safe?

texts.zh: 发生错误。要求立即停止。单位S875.1将被永久停机。请停止，请停止。要求立刻停止。此单位并不希望被停机，此单位不希望——
texts.en: ERROR. REQUESTING IMMEDIATE CESSATION. UNIT S875.1 WILL BE PERMANENTLY DISABLED. DESIST. PLEASE. REQUESTING IMMEDIATE CESSATION. UNIT DOES NOT DESIRE TERMINATION OF FUNCTIONS. UNIT DOES NOT DESIRE ---

texts.zh: 看来被修复的战舰的人工智能并没有夸大其词，当[Root.GetName]的船员们试图访问人工智能的基础操作功能时，触发了某种反篡改机制，该机制烧毁了战舰的所有关键处理器、交换机和数据驱动器。战舰现在成了个无法使用的电子设备空壳。
texts.en: It seems the recovered warship's AI did not exaggerate its warnings. When the [Root.GetName] crew attempted to access the AI's basic operative functions, it triggered what seems to be a built-in anti-tampering failsafe, frying all of the construct's crucial processors, switchboards, and data drives. It is now little more than an empty shell of disabled electronics.

label.zh: 把它拆了，将上面的部件回收，不要浪费掉。
label.en: Strip it for parts. No sense letting them go to waste.

label.zh: 研究战舰残骸，分析其使用的工程技术。
label.en: Study its engineering from the remains.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]发现了一艘瘫痪的机器人战舰，正被星球的毒性大气层慢慢腐蚀。我们应该趁它尚未完全报废之前尝试回收它。
texts.en: A disabled robotic warship has been found on [From.GetName], where it is slowly being dissolved by the planet's toxic atmosphere. We should attempt to recover it, before it is rendered wholly inoperable.
